review_type: AI separate implementation; not independent human review or field utility guarantee

schema.name: assignments
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE assignments(assignment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES customers,arm TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(arm IN('A','B','H')),assigned_day INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(assigned_day>=0),probability REAL NOT NULL)

schema.name: contracts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE contracts(contract_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,assignment_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments,signed_day INTEGER NOT NULL,synthetic_contract_value INTEGER NOT NULL,synthetic_contribution INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: customers
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,region TEXT NOT NULL,interest_model TEXT NOT NULL,lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,sms_consent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sms_consent IN(0,1)),prior_drive INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(prior_drive IN(0,1)),dealer_id TEXT NOT NULL,lead_source TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE events(event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments,event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN('booking','test_drive_completed','contract_signed','consent_withdrawn')),event_day INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: external_sources
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE external_sources(source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,url TEXT NOT NULL,grain TEXT NOT NULL,allowed_analytic_role TEXT NOT NULL,restriction TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: generation_manifest
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE generation_manifest(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value_json TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: messages
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE messages(message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,assignment_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments,attempt_day INTEGER NOT NULL,delivered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(delivered IN(0,1)))

schema.name: early_snapshot_day28
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW early_snapshot_day28 AS SELECT a.assignment_id,a.arm,a.assigned_day,
 CASE WHEN a.assigned_day+28<=28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS primary_window_mature,
 CASE WHEN a.assigned_day+180<=28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS contract_window_mature,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='test_drive_completed' AND e.event_day<=28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completion_observed_so_far
 FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN events e USING(assignment_id) WHERE a.assigned_day<=28 GROUP BY a.assignment_id

schema.name: outcomes
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW outcomes AS SELECT a.assignment_id,a.customer_id,a.arm,a.assigned_day,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='booking' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='test_drive_completed' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='consent_withdrawn' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawn_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='contract_signed' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contracted_180
 FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN events e USING(assignment_id) GROUP BY a.assignment_id

generation_manifest.time_unit: integer days since hypothetical campaign launch; no actual calendar or real campaign
generation_manifest.background_withdrawal_H: Organic consent withdrawal without experimental message, other campaign contacts not modeled
generation_manifest.economic_status: Synthetic contract values, not delivered/recognized vehicle revenue. No actual manufacturer costs.
